content:
The image shows soybean seeds on soil. Key visual features:

- Seeds display prominent pink-to-purple discoloration covering significant portions of the seed coat
- The discoloration is uneven, ranging from yellow/tan on parts of the seed to deep purple blotches
- Some seeds show nearly full purple coverage, others have partial purple staining mixed with yellow
- Seeds appear to be laid out on bare soil, viewed closely

This matches **Purple_Seed_Stain** very well. The symptom description states: "Infected seeds show pink to purple spots ranging from specks to large blotches covering the entire surface, with discoloration extending from the seed hilum." The seeds here show exactly this pattern — partial to full purple-pink discoloration on seed coats, consistent with Cercospora kikuchii causing purple seed stain.

No other class fits: Phomopsis shows gray mold and shriveled seeds; Charcoal_Rot affects stems; Downy_Mildew shows white crusty coating on seeds.
